results.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees receive each year?
results.expected_answer: 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

results.expected_answer: Up to 5 days; they must be used by 31 March of the following year.

results.question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim, and when is a receipt required?
results.expected_answer: Within 30 calendar days of the expense; an itemised receipt is required for each expense above USD 25.
results.response: Expense claims must be submitted through the Expense Portal within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred [Source: HR-003, Chunk: HR-003-CH01]. An itemised receipt is required for every individual expense above USD 25; expenses of USD 25 or less may be claimed without a receipt if a description of the expense is entered [Source: HR-003, Chunk: HR-003-CH02].
